title: EXHIBITION TOUR: MARCEL DUCHAMP
description:
Join us for a one-hour tour led by a specially trained docent. This special tour experience provides a uniquely personal look at the special exhibition, bringing the many stories of the objects to life.

Things to Know:
- Cost is $35 per ticket and includes museum admission.
- Registration is required with limited availability.
- Meet your tour guide at the Information Desk in the Great Stair Hall at the time selected.
- Please allow for additional time for arriving and locating the meeting location.
- Please note that the specific art and galleries on the tour are subject to change.

This special tour requires a paid registration and space is limited. When: Monday, November 9, 2026, 12:00 pm - 1:00 pm. Where: Main Building, Great Stair Hall.
fee: $35 per ticket (includes museum admission); paid registration required
contact_information: Philadelphia Museum of Art, Main Building, 2600 Benjamin Franklin Parkway, Philadelphia, PA 19130; 215-763-8100

title: EXHIBITION TOUR: RODIN’S HANDS
description: Enjoy a guided tour of The Rodin Museum. Experience one of the world's greatest collections of work by sculptor Auguste Rodin. Eternal Springtime, Modeled 1884; cast between 1898-1918, Auguste Rodin (French, 1840–1917) Cast by Ferdinand Barbedienne (French, 1810–1892), F1929-7-18. Things to know: Space is limited to 20 participants. Tour is first come, first served until capacity is met. Tour schedule is subject to change. Weather permitting.
